zotero.abstractNote: Layer Normalization (LN) is a critical component in modern Transformer architectures. While Pre-LN is widely adopted for its training stability, it often suffers from performance degradation in very deep models compared to Post-LN. Conversely, Post-LN offers better performance but is notoriously difficult to train. In this paper, we propose Mix-LN, a simple yet effective approach that combines the benefits of both Pre-LN and Post-LN. By strategically interleaving Pre-LN and Post-LN layers, Mix-LN stabilizes the training process while unleashing the potential of deeper layers. We demonstrate the effectiveness of Mix-LN across various model scales and tasks, showing consistent improvements over standard Pre-LN and Post-LN baselines.
